name: gate-doc-surfacing
title: Surface Gate 3 and Gate 4b docs in the Builds view
outcome: Gate documents (03-program-design.md, epic-<id>-design.md) are readable from the viewer's Builds view, not just from docs/plans/ or a one-off Artifact publish.
done_when: Gate Rail cards in the Builds view open a sheet showing the gate's doc content
Epic cards with an approved 4b design show a design-doc chip that opens the same sheet type
data/index.json carries program_design and epic_design entities projected from docs/plans/<slug>/03-program-design.md and epic-<id>-design.md
abort_if: a gate's doc content duplicates what 00-status.md's approval-state line already shows well enough that a sheet adds no reading value

min_work.derived_from: conversation: colleague session couldn't view Gate 3 progress in the viewer; agreed the Builds Gate Rail is the right home over a new tab or continued artifact publishing
min_work.note: Design mode ran to completion on 2026-09-01: grounded against ADR-0018/ADR-0020 and the viewer/build_index.py source, interviewed, challenged (four alternatives rejected, recorded in intent.json and ADR-0022), drafted ADR-0022, intent.json, assessment.json, narrative.json, pr-draft.md, and diagrams/level-{1,2,3}.mmd. Reviewed and approved in one round, no material feedback.

epics.note: shared/build_index.py: add PROGRAM_DESIGN_FIELDS and EPIC_DESIGN_FIELDS projection tuples plus project_program_design/project_epic_design, following the project_fields(source, fields) pattern used by project_goal/project_intent/project_assessment. Parse docs/plans/<slug>/03-program-design.md and epic-<id>-design.md; emit program_design and epic_design entities into data/index.json. Extend feature_gates join entries with a doc reference where one exists.

plugins/artifact/viewer/index.html: make gate-rail-grid cards (renderBuildsMainContent, ~line 3249) clickable, opening a gate-doc sheet modeled on openAdrSheet. Add a design-doc chip to renderEpicCard (~line 3282) for epics with an epic_design entity.
